{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# First, confirm that commas are present in the string values
print("Before cleaning: First 5 values of revenue:")
print(data['revenue'].head(5))

# Remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check the cleaned values
print("\nAfter cleaning: First 5 values of revenue_clean:")
print(data['revenue_clean'].head(5))

# Confirm no QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Confirm refunded orders are still present
refunded_orders = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")"}
